questions.question: Which one is a simple sentence?

options.a: He was rejected, for his performance was not satisfactory.
options.b: The patient died after the doctor had arrived.
options.c: The man becoming repentant, Allah at last took pity on him.
options.d: Where there is a will, there is a way.

questions.correct_answer_text: The man becoming repentant, Allah at last took pity on him.
questions.explanation: Simple Sentence-এ কেবল একটি Clause এবং একটি finite verb থাকে। ক, খ ও ঘ সবগুলোতে ২টি করে Clause আছে। কেবল গ-তে একটি Clause এবং একটি finite verb 'took' আছে।

questions.question: His family comprises _____ nine members.
questions.explanation: Comprise = অন্তর্ভুক্ত করা। এর পর কোনো Preposition বসে না।

questions.question: It rests ....... the management to justify our actions.
questions.explanation: rest with = কারো দায়িত্বে থাকা। rest upon/on = নির্ভর করা / কোনো জায়গায় স্থির হওয়া।

questions.question: Which of the following is not a feminine gender?
questions.explanation: Sorcerer (যাদুকর) - Sorceress (যাদুকরী)। Jane (আদর্শ ইংরেজ নারী)। Blonde (সোনালী চুল ও বর্ণবিশিষ্ট রমণী)। Termagant (কলহপ্রিয় মহিলা)।

questions.question: I turned pale. Here "turned" is a/an -
questions.explanation: যে verb-এর অর্থ প্রকাশের জন্য complement-এর প্রয়োজন হয় তাকে Linking verb বলে। এখানে 'turned' subject 'I' ও complement 'pale'-এর সম্পর্ক নির্দেশ করছে।

questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: "To blow hot and cold"

options.c: To be inconsistent in opinion or attitude

questions.correct_answer_text: To be inconsistent in opinion or attitude
questions.explanation: এই idiom বোঝায়—একই বিষয়ে কখনো সমর্থন, কখনো বিরোধিতা করা।

questions.question: She prides herself ___ her ability to remain calm under pressure.
questions.explanation: Verb pride oneself সর্বদা on নেয়। "upon" literary variation হলেও competitive exam-এ on সবচেয়ে নিরাপদ।

questions.question: You must do the work. (Change the Voice)

options.a: The work should be done by you.
options.b: The work must be done by you.
options.c: The work may be done by you.
options.d: The work might be done by you.

questions.correct_answer_text: The work must be done by you.
questions.explanation: May, might, can, could, must, ought to যুক্ত Active Voice-কে Passive Voice-এ পরিবর্তন করার সময় এদের পরে be বসে এবং মূল verb-টির Past Participle বসে।

questions.question: Choose the synonym of "Nexus".
questions.explanation: Nexus: A connection or series of connections linking two or more things. Synonyms: join, junction, juncture, intersection, link, connection।

questions.question: At that very moment, he was very tired. Here, 'very' is used respectively as
questions.explanation: প্রথম very – moment (noun) কে modify করায় Adjective। ২য় very – tired (adjective) কে modify করায় Adverb।

questions.question: Fill in the gap: Before leaving for the workplace, I spent ____ with my children.
questions.explanation: Sometime অর্থ কোন এক সময়, Sometimes অর্থ মাঝে মাঝে, Some time অর্থ কিছু সময়।

questions.question: In which sentence is the word 'since' used as a preposition?

options.a: I have not seen him since.
options.b: Nine months have passed since I met him.
options.c: Since he was tired, he could not wait for you.
options.d: Till now since his birth, he has not been taken care of by his parents.

questions.correct_answer_text: Till now since his birth, he has not been taken care of by his parents.
questions.explanation: দুটি Noun এর মধ্যে সংযুক্তসূচক পদকে Preposition বলে। এখানে 'since' দুটি noun (his birth ও the time) এর মধ্যে সংযুক্ত।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

options.a: Would that he could understand my feelings better.
options.b: Would that he could understanded my feelings better.
options.c: Would that he could understanding my feelings better.
options.d: Would that he understand my feelings better.

questions.correct_answer_text: Would that he could understand my feelings better.
questions.explanation: Would that দিয়ে sentence শুরু হলে Subject এরপর could বসে এবং verb এর Present form বসে।

questions.question: Which one is a correct sentence?

options.a: Ten kilometers are too far to walk.
options.b: One should take care of his health.
options.c: Students each are present at today.
options.d: The furniture in the living room need to be cleaned regularly.

questions.correct_answer_text: Students each are present at today.
questions.explanation: Plural Noun/Pronoun এর পর Each বসলে verb Plural হয়।

questions.question: "To forgive is divine." What part of speech is the underlined part -
questions.explanation: To + Verb (To forgive) এখানে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসে subject এর কাজ করেছে। তাই To forgive এখানে Noun।

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.

options.a: You need not worrying about the test; everything will be fine.
options.b: You need not worries about the test; everything will be fine.
options.c: You need not to worry about the test; everything will be fine.
options.d: You need not worry about the test; everything will be fine.

questions.correct_answer_text: You need not worry about the test; everything will be fine.
questions.explanation: Negative sentence এ 'need' modal auxiliary হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হলে need not এর পরে to বসাতে হয় না।

questions.question: They ___ be waiting for you at the station now.
questions.explanation: Speculation (অনুমান) বুঝাতে Present Tense এ May/might ব্যবহার হয়। Structure: Subject + may/might + be + মূল verb এর সাথে ing।

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence.

options.a: It is high time followed your heart.
options.b: It is high time to following your heart.
options.c: It is high time to be followed your heart.
options.d: It is high time to follow your heart.

questions.correct_answer_text: It is high time to follow your heart.
questions.explanation: It is time/It is high time এরপর যদি subject না থাকে তবে to + verb হয়।

questions.question: It was she _____ they invited to the party.
questions.explanation: শূন্যস্থানে who এর object form বসবে। কোনো ব্যক্তি (Person) + whom + subject + verb।

questions.question: All he needed was ________ dollars to fuel his road trips and wandering spirit.
questions.explanation: A few + Countable Noun হয়। 'dollar' countable noun তাই এর পূর্বে a few বসবে।

questions.question: A justice, With every decision, shapes not just the law, but the very fabric of society itself. The underlined word is -
questions.explanation: Justice সাধারণত Abstract noun। কিন্তু uncountable ও abstract nouns এর আগে article ব্যবহার হয় না। এখানে 'A justice' তে article আছে তাই Common noun।

questions.question: He was standing ______ a crowd of children.
questions.explanation: Among: তিনটির বেশি ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর মাঝে।

questions.question: _ pair of socks_ too small for me.
questions.explanation: A/The/This + pair of + plural noun + singular verb। যে সকল noun এর দুটো অংশ থাকে সেগুলো singular determiner + pair of ব্যবহার করলে singular verb নেয়।

questions.question: Pick out the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: Inundate = প্লাবিত করা; অভিভূত করা।

questions.question: Each union elects several delegates ______ the annual conference.
questions.explanation: Delegates to a conference।

questions.question: Satyendranath was a contemporary ____ Rabindranath Tagore.
questions.explanation: Contemporary of: সমসাময়িক।

questions.question: Priya bears --- the first position.
questions.explanation: Bear away/off: জয় করে নেওয়া। Bear on: সম্পর্ক/সংযুক্ত হওয়া। Bear out: সমর্থন করা। Bear with: সহ্য করা।

questions.question: The word "affect" is a/an -
questions.explanation: Affect - আক্রান্ত করা (Verb)। Effect = ফলাফল বা প্রতিক্রিয়া (Noun)।

questions.question: What a nice bird it is! The word "What" is a/an-
questions.explanation: এখানে 'a nice bird' noun phrase কে modify করার কারণে 'what' adjective হয়েছে। 'How' Adjective/Adverb Modify করে।

questions.question: More than one book ___ bought.
questions.explanation: More than one এর পর singular noun এবং singular verb বসে। More than two এর পর plural noun এবং plural verb বসে।

questions.question: Which one is a plural number?
questions.explanation: Locus (singular) - Loci (plural)। hives, draughts দেখতে Plural হলেও singular। Ellipse (singular) - Ellipses (plural)।

questions.question: The antonym of 'confide' is-
questions.explanation: confide = বিশ্বাস করা। suspect = সন্দেহ করা।

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'Few and far between'?
questions.explanation: Few and far between অর্থ কদাচিৎ (rarely)।

questions.question: "Harp on" means-
questions.explanation: "Harp on" অর্থ বারবার একই কথা বলা।

questions.question: No more for today. Here 'no' is -
questions.explanation: No more for today। এখানে 'No' Adjective 'More' কে Modify করেছে। তাই 'No' এখানে Adverb।

questions.question: The antonym of 'dear' is-
questions.explanation: dear অর্থ প্রিয়, দুর্মূল্য। cheap = সস্তা (দুর্মূল্য এর বিপরীত)।

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence-

options.a: He talks as if he knows everything.
options.b: He talks as if he had known everything.
options.c: He talked as though he knew about the matter.
options.d: He talked as though he had known about the matter.

questions.correct_answer_text: He talked as though he had known about the matter.
questions.explanation: Present Tense + as if/as though + past ind। Past ind Tense + as if/as though + past perfect।

questions.question: He helped me finish the work. (Make it passive)

options.a: I was helped by him for finishing the work.
options.b: I was helped for finishing the work by him.
options.c: I was helped by him to finish the work.
options.d: I was helped finishing the work by him.

questions.correct_answer_text: I was helped by him to finish the work.
questions.explanation: Help someone (to) do something এর Passive: be helped by someone to do something।
